title: RESOLUTION (PADILLA - RODRIGUEZ) relative to designating a location in Council District 6 for enforcement against sitting, lying, sleeping, or storing,…
text:
[Council File 26-4118-S11; CD 6]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
RESOLUTION (PADILLA - RODRIGUEZ) relative to designating a location in Council District 6 for enforcement against sitting, lying, sleeping, or storing, using, maintaining, or placing personal property, or otherwise obstructing the public right-of-way, as further detailed in Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC) Section 41.18.
Recommendations for Council action:
1. RESOLVE, pursuant to Section 41.18 (c) of the LAMC, to designate the following location for enforcement against sitting, lying, sleeping, or storing, using, maintaining, or placing personal property, or otherwise obstructing the public right­ of­ way, up to the maximum distance and effective for the maximum period of time prescribed, and as further detailed in the LAMC:
a. 8800 Woodman Avenue, Arleta, CA 91331 - Licensed Day Care
b. 14030 Nordhoff St, Arleta, CA 91331 - Licensed Day Care
c. 13645 Roscoe Blvd, Panorama City, CA 91402- Licensed Day Care
d. 8321 Lennox Ave, Panorama City, CA 91402 - Library
e. 8133 Vineland Ave, Sun Valley, CA 91352 - Sun Valley Recreation Center - Park
f. 6952 Van Nuys Blvd, Van Nuys, CA 91405 - School
g. 6725 Kester Ave, Van Nuys, CA 91405 - School
h. 13906 Van Nuys Blvd, Arleta, CA 91331 - Freeway Ramp
2. RESOLVE to direct and authorize the City department(s) with jurisdiction over the identified locations to post appropriate notices of the above prohibitions at these locations, and to begin enforcement upon the expiration of any required posting period.
